messages:
laura: Quick heads-up — I cut the candidate (build 2026.03.14+7). Pin tag is v2026-rc-7. Please review notes and signal any hard blockers.
mike: grabbing the diff now. Any migrations in this build?
laura: Only a tiny feature-flagged migration that runs with a guard. Not DB-destructive. I'll paste the snippet from the runbook.
laura: ```sql
-- migration: add nullable col; guard via feature flag
ALTER TABLE sessions ADD COLUMN client_metadata JSONB;
``` 
jess: looks safe. feature flag is off by default, right?
laura: yes, off. We'll enable behind the rollout after traffic shift.
sam: deploying KV warm job now for the new embedding model footprint. ETA ~6m.
deploy-bot: :gear: queued promotion job for v2026-rc-7 to prod-stable. Window: 2026-03-14 22:00 UTC — 23:00 UTC. Canary: 5% -> 20% over 15m -> 100% after 45m. Tracing hooks attached.
sheriff: I can monitor the canary window. Please ensure the alert thresholds are set — 3x 5xx, latency p50 > 350ms, error budget burn > 2% in 10m.
laura: thresholds set in the console. Also added a rollback play in the release notes: if canary error rate > 1.5% for 5m, we abort and rollback to v2025-stable.
mike: ack. Do we have an automated rollback script or manual only?
laura: automated revert is enabled but requires ops approval to execute. ops-bot will open a rollback ticket if threshold is breached.
ops-bot: :clipboard: rollback runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-rollback
jess: release notes live at https://docs.redwood.com/releases/2026-03-14-rc7 — I added the user-facing bullet and the dev changelog.
sam: KV warming done. Logs: ```
kv-warmer: complete — 12 shards warmed, avg latency 42ms
``` 
mike: smoke test pass on staging with the pinned tag. Tests: kube e2e, embed service smoke, auth smoke all green.
laura: cool. Two final asks before we lift: 1) confirm monitoring dashboards have the new metric panels, 2) legal sign-off on telemetry change (we have ack from privacy).
mike: dashboards ok. legal ack received via email.
sheriff: I'll be available during the window. If anything odd, ping me and we'll flip the deadman.
laura: deploying canary now in 10. Starting the quiet window at 22:00 UTC. If no objections, I'll hit promote at T+0.
mike: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: :rocket: promotion started — canary group created (5% traffic). Link: https://deploy.redwood/prod/promotions/3141592653
deploy-bot: :warning: canary metrics streaming: error_rate=0.12% p50=120ms p95=420ms
jess: watching UX traces — no regressions observed so far.
sheriff: monitoring ok. no alert spikes.
laura: proceeding to ramp to 20% in 15m.
deploy-bot: :rocket: ramping to 20% completed. telemetry: error_rate=0.20% p50=140ms p95=430ms
laura: all green. scheduling full rollout in 30m unless anyone yells.
mike: +1
jess: +1
sheriff: +1 — standing by.
laura: full rollout initiated.
deploy-bot: :tada: promotion to 100% completed. final metrics: error_rate=0.18% p50=150ms p95=410ms
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: post-deploy checks passed. Closing release card.
laura: thanks team. I'll follow up with the short postmortem checklist tomorrow and tag the changelog for the stable release.
mike: great job. saved the roll-forward playbook to the repo.
sheriff: closing watch. good job everyone :party_parrot:
